integrity: The universal membership criterion is proved symbolically.
The finite enumeration is exhaustive over all subsets of the 15 nonzero linear polynomials.
Every computationally rejected closure has an explicit replayed factor witness.
limitations: Only the three-variable case \(\mathbb B[x,y,z]\) is proved.
Ideals containing all three variables and ideals with nonlinear generators are outside the claim.
Search coverage cannot logically certify novelty against undiscovered or differently indexed literature.

title: The three-variable linear-prime conjecture for the Boolean polynomial semiring
